answer.reason: The verses tell of Hamor's plea to Jacob for Dinah and of his persuading his city to be circumcised, which adds to the summary.

clauses.english: asked Jacob's family to give Dinah to his son Shechem as wife
clauses.quote: I pray you give her him to wife.

clauses.english: persuaded the men of his city to be circumcised

doubts: GEN 33:19 and the other mentions of the 'sons of Hamor' (JOS 24:32, ACT 7:16) name his sons or descendants as the sellers of the field, so I left them out.
JDG 9:28 only names Hamor as ancestor of the men of Shechem, so it was not used.
ACT 7:16 calls him Emmor and names Abraham as the buyer, which differs from GEN 33:19; I did not use it.
